metadata.author: Dorathea Lee
metadata.description: This protocol uses the Thermo Easy Pep Mini MS Kit reagents to perform reduction/alkylation/digestion. Samples must be loaded already normalized to 1ug/uL in 100uL of Lysis buffer. Protocol ends with digestion stop solution, at this point samples should be frozen unless proceeding to cleanup.
